email_body:
Hello,

I saw your Survey Draftsperson advert for the Gosford office on SEEK and would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings and checking work against project requirements. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, office and regional work.

Your advert asks for Civil 3D and drawings that are accurate and complete, and in my course I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. My Civil 3D use is from study rather than paid production work, I have not prepared survey plans yet, and I am open to discussing relocation to the Central Coast.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a short call about the role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I saw your SEEK advert for a Survey Draftsperson in the Gosford office, and I would like to be considered for the role. Your advert asks for Civil 3D and careful checking of drawings for accuracy, which match what I did in my course and on site.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements to cut down on errors and rework, and kept site reports and material records.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My Civil 3D and AutoCAD work is from study rather than paid production drafting, and I have not prepared survey plans yet, so I would start at entry level. I am open to discussing relocation to the Central Coast for this role.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about how I could support your Gosford drafting work.
